candidates.title: SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models
candidates.abstract: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.
candidates.reason: VLMの言語バックボーンを対象とする重みのみの超低ビット量子化。8次元重みを符号・半径・正方向へ分解し、外れ値の影響を半径の高精度表現で抑える。共有メモリ内で小型方向コードブックを参照するGEMVカーネルも設計し、著者要旨ではRTX A6000でQTIPよりdecode throughputが30.3%高い。画像認識のみではなく自回帰VLM推論の圧縮・カーネルに直接適用されるためaccept。

candidates.title: Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE
candidates.abstract: Deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models relies heavily on Expert Parallelism, which generates intense inter-GPU communication. Consequently, state-of-the-art inference systems require high-bandwidth, P2P interconnects (e.g., NVLink) in datacenter GPUs to handle massive token routing, making deployment prohibitively expensive. Consumer GPUs offer comparable compute power at significantly lower cost, promising to democratize MoE inference for individuals and enable privacy-preserving local deployments. However, their bandwidth-limited (only weak PCIe bus bandwidth) and host-mediated interconnects (no P2P support) introduce severe communication bottlenecks. We present CoMoE, a communication-efficient MoE inference system that resolves this mismatch through novel host-centric routing. Our key insight is that the unique communication topology provides the opportunity to elevate the host to an active routing hub, which can fundamentally reduce communication volume and eliminate global synchronization-induced stalls. Specifically, for token dispatch, we introduce host-backed token multicast to write shared tokens to the host exactly once, eliminating outbound transmission redundancy. For token combine, we propose a fine-grained, token-level aggregation mechanism using host staging buffers, which replaces rigid global synchronization and mitigates straggler effects. Evaluation on RTX 5090 GPUs shows that CoMoE improves inference throughput by up to 1.46x, approaching the performance of NVLink-capable A800 GPUs at only 23.4% of the hardware cost.
candidates.reason: NVLinkやP2P転送を持たない民生GPU複数台のMoE expert parallelismを対象とする。ホストをルーティングハブとして共有tokenを一度だけホストへ書き込むmulticast dispatchと、ホストステージングを使ったtoken単位のcombineを提案し、転送重複と全体同期を抑える。著者のarXiv登録要旨ではRTX 5090上で推論スループット最大1.46倍、A800/NVLink相当の性能にハードウェア費用23.4%で接近したと報告。MoE推論通信の直接的なシステム研究としてaccept。

candidates.title: An Optical KV Cache Network for Disaggregated LLM Serving
candidates.abstract: In disaggregated LLM serving, each request's KV cache moves from a prefill GPU to a decode GPU before the response begins, and a coding-agent turn often moves the KV cache of its whole long context. Behind an oversubscribed packet fabric, this transfer adds to the time to first token (TTFT). An optical circuit switch (OCS) can give every transfer a full-rate circuit for less than an oversubscribed packet fabric costs, but a mechanical OCS needs tens of milliseconds to reconfigure. We hide this delay inside the prefill. A reservation scheduler commits each circuit while the prefill is still computing, so the circuit is ready when the KV cache is, and each GPU reaches the OCS through its own wavelength-multiplexed (WDM) optics on one fiber pair. In simulations of GPU clusters on real serving traces with prefill times measured on H100 GPUs, this optical KV cache network matches 400G packet fabrics with adaptive routing at 0.55 to 0.78 times the cost of a 2:1 fabric and tolerates the 50 ms reconfiguration delay of a 384-port mechanical OCS.
candidates.reason: prefill/decode分離でKVを移送する際、パケット網の過剰収容によるTTFT悪化を光回線交換で緩和する提案。機械式光スイッチの再構成時間をprefill中の予約確定で隠し、各GPUへWDM接続する。著者要旨の実トレースに基づくシミュレーションでは、50ms再構成遅延を許容しつつ400G適応ルーティング網と同等性能を2:1ファブリック費用の0.55～0.78倍で達成すると報告。ネットワーク設計を通じたKV転送高速化としてaccept。ただし実ネットワークでの運用実測ではない。

candidates.title: Efficient CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference via Adaptive Expert Assignment
candidates.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce inference computation through sparse expert activation, but their large expert memory footprint often exceeds GPU capacity, making expert offloading necessary for memory-constrained inference. However, existing systems typically handle GPU-missed experts by either transferring them to the GPU, incurring substantial PCIe transfer latency, or executing them on the CPU, making the slower CPU computation the bottleneck. To address these limitations, we present \method, a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns these missed experts to the CPU or GPU for efficient execution. By exploiting differences in expert token-loads, \method selectively transfers high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU. To minimize inference latency, \method adaptively adjusts expert assignments to balance the CPU computation path against the GPU transfer-and-computation path, allowing both execution paths to complete as early as possible. Extensive experiments on three representative MoE LLMs show that \method improves prefill speed by up to 51.9\% and decode throughput by up to 39.5\% over the strongest baseline across the evaluated batch sizes, with consistent gains under different GPU-memory budgets.
candidates.reason: GPUに載らないMoE expertをすべて転送するかCPUで処理するかの二者択一ではなく、expert別のtoken負荷に応じて高負荷expertをGPUへ転送し、低負荷expertをCPUで実行する。CPU演算経路とPCIe転送＋GPU演算経路の終了時刻を均衡させる割当を適応調整する。著者のarXiv登録要旨は3種類のMoE LLMで最良比較方式に対しprefill最大51.9%、decode throughput最大39.5%改善を報告。CPU/GPU協調オフロードの直接的貢献としてaccept。

candidates.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
candidates.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) imposes substantial memory requirements for the key-value (KV) cache. Token-selective sparse attention reduces attention computation and memory traffic, but KV entries must still be retained for future queries. KV storage capacity therefore remains a constraint on decoding concurrency. Combining GPU and CPU memory expands this capacity but requires efficient access across heterogeneous memory pools. We present UlaCache, a KV cache management system that provides unified logical addressing across GPU and CPU memory. Its logical-slot interface enables the inference engine to allocate, write, access, and release KV entries using stable identifiers across attention parallelism modes. UlaCache manages physical placement, residency, and transfers, updating address mappings after KV transfers. Parallel Bucketed LRU (PB-LRU) reduces the overhead of KV replacement by parallelizing recency updates and eviction-candidate selection within a GPU memory pool shared across requests. We evaluate UlaCache against state-of-the-art baselines. Under tensor-parallel attention (TP), UlaCache provides up to $11.4\times$ the usable KV cache capacity of HiSparse. For GLM-5.3 on eight H200 GPUs, UlaCache achieves peak decoding throughput of $1.10\times$ and $1.59\times$ that of HiSparse under data-parallel attention (DPA) and TP, respectively. For HY4 Preview on eight B300 GPUs, the corresponding throughput ratios are $1.27\times$ and $1.93\times$.
candidates.reason: GPU/CPUに分散するKVを安定した論理アドレスで参照し、物理配置からsparse attentionのKV選択を分離する。分散時はGPU側の選択済みKVを保持し、不足分のみ転送する。CPU格納を使う構成では並列化したPB-LRUがGPU共有プールを管理する。著者要旨はH200とB300のDP/TP構成で最大1.16～2.51倍のdecode throughputを報告しており、KV管理・疎注意・サービングの直接的なシステム貢献としてaccept。
